description: We came to touch grass, accidentally touched satellite data instead. 🛰️ A bunch of sleep-deprived humans armed with caffeine, questionable code, and one dangerously ambitious idea. We break things, fix them, call it innovation, and somehow turn NASA data into something useful. If it involves satellites, AI, Earth, maps, or making a laptop question its life choices—we're probably doing it.
summary:
SatQuery AI is an AI-powered Earth observation platform designed to make satellite data easier to understand and use for environmental monitoring. It combines visual question answering, bi-temporal satellite image analysis, and NASA FIRMS active fire data to support faster interpretation of Earth's changing conditions.

The platform uses a vision-language model to interpret satellite imagery and answer natural-language questions, while its temporal analysis pipeline compares satellite images from different dates to identify environmental changes. Its NASA Fire Intelligence module integrates active fire observations to help users explore fire locations and monitor potential wildfire activity.

By bringing satellite imagery, AI-based interpretation, and geospatial information into one platform, SatQuery AI aims to make Earth observation more accessible, informative, and useful for environmental awareness and decision support.
details:
Project Overview

SatQuery AI is an intelligent satellite data analysis platform that combines artificial intelligence, computer vision, and geospatial processing to make Earth observation more accessible.

How It Works

The platform consists of three major capabilities:

1. AI-Powered Satellite Image Question Answering

SatQuery AI uses Qwen2.5-VL 3B with a fine-tuned LoRA adapter to interpret satellite imagery and answer questions in natural language. Users can ask questions about image contents and receive AI-generated interpretations.

2. Bi-Temporal Change Detection

The platform analyzes satellite imagery captured at different points in time. Its temporal analysis pipeline identifies and interprets changes between images, helping users understand environmental and geographical transformations.

3. NASA Fire Intelligence

The platform integrates NASA FIRMS active fire observations to visualize and explore detected fire locations. This provides an additional layer of information for wildfire awareness and environmental monitoring.

Technologies Used

  • Python
  • Streamlit
  • PyTorch
  • Qwen2.5-VL 3B
  • LoRA fine-tuning
  • Hugging Face Transformers
  • BitsAndBytes 4-bit quantization
  • Rasterio and geospatial processing
  • NASA FIRMS data services
  • Plotly for interactive visualization

Benefits and Intended Impact

SatQuery AI reduces the complexity of interpreting satellite imagery by allowing users to interact with Earth observation data using natural language. Its change analysis and fire intelligence capabilities can support environmental monitoring, research, and awareness of changing conditions on Earth.

Creativity and Innovation

The key innovation is combining natural-language satellite image interpretation, temporal change analysis, and active fire intelligence in one platform. Instead of requiring users to manually interpret multiple satellite datasets, SatQuery AI provides an integrated AI-assisted approach to exploring Earth observation information.

The project was developed with consideration for computational limitations, data accessibility, model efficiency, and the practical usability of satellite information.
